choices.artifact_window: ends 1 ms before the earliest fit sample, so the template never overlaps the response window (REQ-061)

notes.threshold_role: select: the candidates are the extrema above detection_threshold (spec 5.5.3 step 3); on the five development runs of ds004080 the N1 decision agreed better with both readings of the published rule than with 'order' (kappa 0.40/0.39 against 0.36/0.31), 1.4 times faster (CHANGELOG 'Defaults settled by measurement'; v1.1)
notes.detections: N1 (v1.2): the fitted curve has a trough in 9-50 ms deeper than 3.4 times the fit's noise SD (evoparam.models.curve_detection), instead of a negative component in 9-50 ms; on six development runs of ds004080 the agreement with the published rule's N1 detections moved from kappa 0.50 to 0.87 pooled (DECISIONS 5.12). k = 3.4 is the published rule's factor, applied to the fit's own noise SD
